facts.text: The hotel is steps from Ebisu Station, within Yebisu Garden Place, one stop from Shibuya.
facts.excerpt: Just steps from Ebisu Station in Tokyo, our hotel is set within the lush greenery and cultural charm of Yebisu Garden Place. Located one stop from Shibuya

facts.text: Ebisu is a quiet upscale area of central Tokyo, moments from Shibuya, Daikanyama, Roppongi and Tokyo Tower.
facts.excerpt: The Westin Tokyo is situated in Ebisu, a quiet upscale area in central Tokyo, only moments away from Tokyo's thriving business and cultural centers like Shibuya, Daikanyama, Roppongi and Tokyo Tower.

facts.text: The Westin Garden was designed by landscape artist Kazuyuki Ishihara and has 300 flower varieties, seasonal blooms and a stream.
facts.excerpt: Discover the Westin Garden - an urban oasis designed by world-renowned landscape artist Kazuyuki Ishihara. Boasting 300 flower varieties, seasonal blooms, and a tranquil stream

facts.text: The lobby is designed around the concept of an orangery.
facts.excerpt: The lobby is designed around the concept of an orangery

facts.text: The Lounge has a 10-meter atrium with marble columns and serves afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy an elegant afternoon tea at our downtown Tokyo restaurant with a seasonal view. The Lounge, crowned by a stunning 10-meter atrium, features majestic marble columns

facts.text: Room design blends European elements with the surrounding greenery.
facts.excerpt: The Westin Tokyo's design concept seamlessly blends authentic European elements with the natural surroundings and their connection to the area

facts.text: Rooms have urban views, including Tokyo Tower.
facts.excerpt: our rooms feature sweeping urban views, including Tokyo Tower

facts.text: The Westin Club, on the top floor, has views of Tokyo Tower and offers Executive room and suite guests breakfast, light snacks and evening cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Located on the top floor of our hotel in Tokyo city center, the Westin Club offers sweeping views of Tokyo Tower

facts.text: Le Spa Parisien offers facial and body treatments in a classical French style.
facts.excerpt: In the ambiance of classical French style, starting with personal service and consultation, Le Spa Parisien offers variety of treatments

facts.text: A Run Concierge recommends routes around the hotel and leads group runs when available.
facts.excerpt: Discover scenic routes around the hotel recommended by our Run Concierge, or join a group run led by a Run Concierge when available.

facts.text: The Terrace, the all-day buffet restaurant, opens onto The Westin Garden.
facts.excerpt: The Terrace draws on the area’s streams and greenery, seamlessly connecting its airy, spacious interior with The Westin Garden.

facts.text: Escalier is a bar behind a hidden door with panoramic views of Tokyo Tower.
facts.excerpt: In a hideaway-like space behind a hidden door, enjoy cocktails available only here. Enjoy a luxurious experience with panoramic views of Tokyo Tower at our sky bar in downtown Tokyo.

facts.text: The teppanyaki restaurant serves Yebisu Beef with views of Mount Fuji.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Yebisu Beef, one of the finest wagyu varieties, known for its superb marbling and rich flavor, with selected ingredients prepared by the chef before you with dramatic flair, complemented by views of Mount Fuji.

facts.text: Haneda Airport is the closest airport, about 15 kilometers away.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The Westin Tokyo is Tokyo International Airport - Haneda (HND). HND is located approximately 15.0 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel holds Green Key eco-label certification.
facts.excerpt: The Westin Tokyo has earned the internationally recognized Green Key eco-label certification.
